intention: /sorted's cast rides a door: the inward completeness answers, the node class, the bound gates, and the watchme spec become a packet fired through skill_block — refused incomplete in one pass, berthed on pass, traced either way. A partial cast then survives on disk as a refused trace or a berth instead of dying with the context, and the cast ticket carries its sorted berth the way it already carries its intent berth.
why: Rank 3 of notes/2026-08-02-opus-compatibility-pass.json, ruled spec by 2026-08-03-projections-stand: a pressed smaller-model session writes watchme 'none, because <one plausible sentence>' and every downstream gate stays green forever; and if the context dies mid-/sorted, nothing on disk holds the partial cast — type, gates, watchme spec, children all lived only in the transcript. /sorted's OWN charter already names the debt: 'casting has no chokepoint (filing a ticket is writing a file) ... a tracked debt (Law 4), not a resting state.' This ticket pays that declared IOU with the machinery built for exactly this — the /intent migration is the template, and this is the template claim's first LIVE test (intent ticket falsifier 5; skill_block falsifier 3).
traces_to: Law 4 — the casting discipline is prose in SKILL.md today, and the charter itself calls that a tracked debt
Law 1 — a partial cast dying with the context forces re-derivation; a refused packet on disk is the settled answer surviving
Law 7 — the door names every lack in one pass at a diagnostic surface, replacing four self-answered prose questions

gates.prove_gate: derivation gate — `cairn cairnmap --gate` green: /sorted renders from its intention+why.json (the charter changes in this build — the gate is live, not ceremonial).
gates.proof_gate: proof teeth through the tester where this touches code — the contract in the charter, any composed judge the watchme-reason check needs, and the downstream consumer's check. Sealed netns, validation beside the code.
gates.durability_gate: not done until proven AND durably committed (git).

watchme.trigger: every /sorted cast firing in the trace berth — door_pass and refusal alike
watchme.enough: BOTH edges demonstrated live: the door has refused at least one real cast, AND at least one refused cast was fixed and refired to a berth (recovery works for the model the door exists to help). Until both exist the migration is unfalsified, not proven. Akien may retire the watch by ruling.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier — firing count, refusal count, recovery count, and the denominator they are counted against
watchme.nexus: /sorted's trace berth plus the verdict corpus in CairnCommons/learning/ — same store as the parent's akien-gate-dial, narrower scope
watchme.consumer: Akien. Distinct from akien-gate-dial on purpose: the dial asks 'can this gate be delegated'; this asks 'does the cast door ever actually RED' — the vacuity question rank 3 named.

falsifier: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) a firing passes with any completeness answer, node class, gate binding, or watchme field empty — an empty collection is the absence of a value wearing the field's name; (2) watchme 'none, because <X>' passes on non-blank alone — the reason must be judgeable, and a check that cannot tell a reason from a sentence is the hollow pass rank 3 measured; (3) migrating /sorted required a skill_block source change — the template claim breaks, measured not asserted (the seam's own bytes-identical tooth is the instrument); (4) a mid-cast context death leaves nothing on disk — no refused trace, no berth; (5) a ticket filed by a cast that never fired the door reaches BUILDME with no sorted berth and no named exemption, and the gate stays green — the third leg (downstream consumer) unwired, discipline wearing physics' clothes.
horizon: Re-read when the next roster member (/saveslate, voyage 4 of the ruled sequence) migrates — the template claim is then measured a second time. The watch's own horizon is the first window in which /sorted casts real work through the door.
